steps.name: just started: every step open, the longest wording of each

commands.data: Lyren wants your townsfolk doing skilled work. Set up one workplace from start to finish: unlock a kind of work, mark out its ground, choose what it is and give it its bench. Any kind of work will do.

1. Unlock a workplace type. Talk to Garren Vale, the Blacksmith, at the Blacksmith shop and ask to upgrade the building and workplaces. On the Workplaces tab, unlock one of these for 100 gold: Smelting, Blacksmithing, Armor Crafting. Other villagers in town can unlock other types.
2. Mark out a workplace. Hold a Building Staff (crafted at the Town Planning Desk), open its mode menu and choose Create workplace, then mark two opposite corners on the ground inside your town.
3. Choose the workplace's type. Marking out an area opens the workplace page. Unlock a type first, then pick its card, name the workplace and press Save.
4. Place the bench its type needs inside your workplace. Your town has no workplace at the moment, so mark one out and choose its type first. This step will then name the bench.
5. Tell Elder Lyren your workplace is ready. He will say how to put townsfolk to work in it.
